```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(pastclim)
library(tictoc)
```

Create a dataset
```{r}
locations <- data.frame(
  name = c("Iho Eleru", "La Riera", "Chalki", "Oronsay", "Atlantis"),
  longitude = c(5, -4, 27, -6, -24), latitude = c(7, 44, 36, 56, 31),
  time_bp = c(-511200, -318738, -10227, -1200, -211600)
)
locations
locations2 <- locations
locations2$longitude <- locations2$longitude + 5
locations2$latitude <- locations2$latitude -2
locations2$time_bp <- locations2$time_bp - 10000
locations2$name <- paste0(locations2$name, "_2")
locations <- rbind(locations, locations2)
locations
```

Extract locations
```{r}
tic()
location_slice(
  x = locations, bio_variables = c("bio01", "bio12", "bio15", "npp"),
  dataset = "Krapp2021"
)
toc()
```
